summary.text: At the academy on Tolaria, Urza, seeing the Phyrexian invasion coming, secretly begins the Bloodline Project, arranging marriages between families strong in white mana to create mortal heroes who can wield the Legacy against Yawgmoth.
He also creates the Metathran army amid controversy, as Barrin contests his methods and some researchers quit, while his geneticist Gatha defects and uses his knowledge to improve the Keldon race.
The Phyrexians then launch a preemptive strike on project sites, killing thousands, though Gerrard survives, carried to Jamuura by Karn.
